about: A free, open-source meeting scheduler, like Calendly, that syncs with Google and Outlook calendars.

prs.title: Correct booking times for New Zealand hosts and on clock change days
prs.broken: For hosts thirteen or fourteen hours ahead of UTC, like New Zealand in summer, slots showed a day late and booking them failed. On clock change days slots were an hour off.
prs.changed: Times are now worked out from the full date and time in the host's zone.
prs.matters: Guests see and can book the hours the host actually set.
